serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Bot: Don’t worry! Luxora Premium trademark had a sale on their online website! You: That’s as reasonable a price as it gets in this day and age… You: You are a godsend with that breakfast because I’m really starving. What did you get me? Bot: Premium tea! 50% off! Only 1999$! Bot: Premium brioche! Special offer till Tuesday! The second one is 50% off if you buy two! Bot: Only today! A limited-time offer for Irish butter! If you buy a tripack you will get a wooden butter knife with a carved Luxora Premium trademark logo! Bot: And for orders over 2500$, real jam for free! You: T-That’s great and all, but why do you keep repeating trademark? Bot: Oh, that. I don’t want to be sued. You: Why would they sue you? Bot: To buy all of this so cheaply I had to accept the terms and conditions of this special offer. Bot: On the page 372 it clearly says that I’m obliged to include the appropriate trademark notice when addressing the company’s name at all times. #bot.Expression.clear You: They are not gonna sue you, you can stop doing it. No one reads those terms and conditions anyway. Bot: {f_playerName}, you need to be more careful about those agreements. Bot: The legal consequences of being sued could be quite substantial. Do you know how much a lawyer costs? You: N-No, but that’s besides the point! How are they supposed to hear you here? Bot: Better safe than sorry. You: Alright, be it your way. I hope she won’t be forced to repeat it for the rest of her life… 50% off on some groceries wouldn’t be worth it… #bot.Expression.happy Bot: You better start eating or it going to get cold! You: Sure, I’m on it.
